movie.title: Clay
movie.overview: A terrible mentor named Flip must look after a newborn ball of clay named Mushi.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a selfish and terrible mentor named Flip is tasked with raising a newborn ball of clay named Mushi, he must overcome his own flaws to shape a fragile young life.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In a colorful world where life is sculpted from scratch, Flip is perhaps the least qualified figure to guide a newborn. Everything changes when he is unexpectedly given sole responsibility over Mushi, an innocent and malleable young ball of clay. As Flip navigates the chaotic demands of mentorship, he slowly learns that his actions directly mold Mushi's growth and personality. Through trial, error, and shared warmth, Flip is forced to confront his self-centered nature to become the guardian Mushi truly needs.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Flip has spent his life avoiding genuine responsibility, gaining a reputation as a neglectful and self-absorbed mentor. His comfortable, carefree existence comes to a sudden halt when he is entrusted with Mushi, a freshly formed, highly sensitive ball of clay. Initially, Flip views the newborn as little more than an annoying burden that disrupts his routine. Mushi, eager to learn and eager to impress, constantly absorbs the energy and behavior of the environment, mirroring Flip's reckless habits. Realizing that his poor guidance is physically and emotionally warping Mushi's fragile form, Flip faces a harsh reality check. He begins taking tentative steps toward real caregiving, protecting Mushi from external dangers while attempting to smooth out his own rough edges. As the two spend more time together, a deep, tender bond develops, teaching Flip the true meaning of patience and sacrifice. When a crisis threatens to break Mushi, Flip must step up and prove he can be more than just a terrible mentor. Ultimately, Flip learns that reshaping himself is the only way to help Mushi realize its full potential.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Clay is a heart-warming animated drama that explores the unexpected burdens and rewards of mentorship and parenthood. The story focuses on Flip, a reluctant guardian whose past failures make him an unlikely candidate to care for anyone, let alone a vulnerable creature. Enter Mushi, a bright and impressionable newborn ball of clay who reacts to every touch, word, and emotion in its surroundings. Designed for audiences of all ages, the film balances comedic misadventures with poignant family drama as Flip learns to navigate the delicate art of guidance, highlighting how love and dedicated care can mold even the most flawed individuals into true heroes.

story_structure.climax: A critical situation tests Flip's commitment, forcing a decisive choice between his self-absorbed tendencies and Mushi's well-being.
story_structure.conflict: Flip struggles to manage the demands of caretaking while clashing with Mushi's unpredictable nature and his own deep-seated flaws.
story_structure.resolution: The aftermath of the crisis establishes a transformed dynamic between Flip and Mushi, reshaping Flip's approach to mentorship.
story_structure.introduction: Flip, an ill-suited and reluctant mentor, is tasked with the unexpected responsibility of taking care of Mushi, a newborn ball of clay.
story_structure.risingAction: As Flip and Mushi spend more time together, escalating challenges force Flip to confront his bad habits while trying to shape and protect the fragile new life.
